item.title: Krasotki, otstan'te! Ja lish' hochu smotret' anime i igrat' v videoigry! Hentaj izdanie
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: azaly
  • 発売日: 2021-01-17
  • スコア: 4.5/10 (36 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Красотки, отстаньте! Я лишь хочу смотреть аниме и играть в видеоигры! Хентай издание
  • 英語名: Ecchi na Onnanoko-tachi, Mou Hanatte Oite! Ore wa Tada Game Shite Anime o Mitai Dake! - Hentai Edition

あらすじ

You want to find a girl, but you are constantly distracted by something. Right during dates, you receive notifications about the premiere of a new series of your favorite anime, or about the release of the long-awaited game, or about a sudden Vtuber’s stream. You know how to prioritize correctly, so you should get rid of the girl on a date as quickly and less painfully as possible… or succumb to temptation?
